title: AgentOps: What It Does, Pricing, and Alternatives (2026) | Inference.net

facts.fact: According to the page, AgentOps' Basic plan is free and includes 5,000 events per month, with core features only.
facts.quote: | Basic | Free | 5,000 events/mo | Core features only |

facts.fact: According to the page, AgentOps' Pro plan starts at $40 per month, with full details available only through sales.
facts.quote: | Pro | From $40/mo | Higher volumes, retention | Full details via sales |

facts.fact: According to the page, AgentOps' Enterprise plan is priced custom and includes SLA, SSO, and self-hosting, with SOC-2, HIPAA, and NIST AI RMF listed as notable gates.
facts.quote: | Enterprise | Custom | SLA, SSO, self-hosting | SOC-2, HIPAA, NIST AI RMF |

facts.fact: The page states that AgentOps' standalone pricing page returned a 404 error when the author checked it, so the tier figures were taken from the agentops.ai homepage instead.
facts.quote: The standalone pricing page returned a 404 when we checked in June 2026, so the numbers below come from the homepage itself.
